d:
Rajasthan men sarkari skulon ki yah tasvir aapko hairan kar sakti hai. kahin mandir men bachchon ki parhaee ho rahi hai, to kahin kisi gramin ke ghar men skul sanchalit ho raha hai aur kahin gram panchayat karyalay hi skul ban gaya hai.
Riport: mohar sinh mina
